research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shopify is researching systems and methods for mobile point-of-sale transactions, secure pin entry via mobile devices, and e-commerce checkout with delay loading of checkout options. Efforts also include balancing online stores across servers, server load balancing based on correlated events, and tokenization of sensitive data for e-commerce platforms. Additional work covers augmented reality enabled dynamic product presentation and providing product image recommendations. These areas reflect Shopify’s focus on commerce platform optimization, security, and user experience.

overview_description.description: Shopify is a commerce platform that provides tools for businesses to build, manage, and grow online and offline stores. It offers website creation, shopping cart functionality, payment processing, inventory management, and order fulfillment solutions within a unified system. The platform supports multichannel selling across web, mobile, social media, marketplaces, and physical retail through point-of-sale technology. Shopify also provides marketing tools, analytics, shipping integrations, and developer resources that enable customization and application development. Its services support entrepreneurs, small businesses, and larger brands seeking infrastructure to operate direct-to-consumer and business-to-business commerce operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Shopify is a commerce platform that provides tools for businesses to build, manage, and grow online and offline stores.

product.name: Shopify Commerce Platform
product.description: A cloud-based commerce platform for creating and managing online stores, product catalogs, checkout, orders, inventory, marketing, analytics, and customer relationships.

product.name: Shopify Plus
product.description: An enterprise commerce platform for high-volume and complex businesses, providing advanced administration, automation, customization, and multichannel selling capabilities.

product.name: Shopify Payments
product.description: An integrated payment processing service that lets merchants accept card and other supported payments, manage payouts, and monitor transactions within Shopify.

product.name: Shopify POS
product.description: A point-of-sale system for selling in physical locations, processing payments, managing inventory, and synchronizing retail orders and customer data with Shopify online stores.

product.name: Shopify Shipping
product.description: Shipping and fulfillment tools that help merchants buy and print shipping labels, calculate rates, track deliveries, and manage shipments from Shopify.

product.name: Shopify Capital
product.description: Business financing services that provide eligible Shopify merchants with access to funding based on business activity and repayment arrangements.
